title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E09 — And a Town Called Feud
When a town's Civil War re-enactment is plagued by ghosts, the Librarians have to uncover the truth of what really happened there over 100 years ago.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E10 — And Some Dude Named Jeff
After switching bodies with a 28-year-old slacker named Jeff, Jenkins enlists the help of Jeff's hapless friends to find his way back into the Library to correct the mistake.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E11 — And the Trial of the One
It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E12 — And the Echoes of Memory
The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E01 — And the Crown of King Arthur
Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E02 — And the Sword in the Stone
The Serpent Brotherhood is trying to return magic to the world; Flynn, Colonel Baird, and the potential Librarians must stop them before it's too late.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E03 — And the Horns of a Dilemma
The librarians' first solo mission hits a snag when Baird loses the others in a mysterious labyrinth that magically exists below the skyscraper of a modern corporation.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E04 — And Santa's Midnight Run
When the Serpent Brotherhood wants to kill Santa, the librarians must rescue him and help him accomplish the secret purpose of Christmas.

title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
description: A caretaker beneath a metropolitan library protects magical artifacts from those who would use them to do evil.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E07 — And the Disenchanted Forest
When dissension threatens the group, Baird takes the Librarians to a charismatic self-help guru's team-building camp on the edge of a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.

title: The Librarians
description:
S04 E08 — And the Hidden Sanctuary
Cassandra decides to take a vacation after she freezes up during a mission; during her visit to Havenport, labeled the "Safest Town in America," Cassandra believes things may not be as ideal as they seem.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E14 — The Boys' Night Out Job
Nate, Eliot and Hardison must intervene when Hurley is caught up in a drug deal.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E15 — The Lonely Hearts Job
When a wealthy businessman asks the team to find his missing wife, they learn the missing woman is part of a ring of grifters running Sweetheart Scams, in which pretty young women woo and wed older men for their money.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E16 — The Gold Job
The team targets a corrupt pair of siblings and steers them through an elaborate treasure hunt.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E17 — The Radio Job
Latimer hires Nate's father to do a heist in a government office; the team must stage a hostage stand-off when they are trapped inside a building.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E18 — The Last Dam Job
The team is forced to recruit old friends and rivals in order to take down Latimer and an enemy from their past.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E01 — The (Very) Big Bird Job
A shipping CEO's cost-cutting measures result in a plane crash; the team cons a CEO into buying the Spruce Goose.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E02 — The Blue Line Job
The team tries to keep a hockey enforcer from sustaining permanent injury in the playoffs.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E03 — The First Contact Job
The team tries to convince a wealthy scientist, who stole from his former research partner, that he has made first contact with aliens.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E04 — The French Connection Job
The team attempts to bring down a restaurateur who destroys lives in his pursuit of fame and money.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E05 — The Gimme a K Street Job
The team must tackle Congress in order to bring down a competitive cheerleading company that profits by putting teenage girls at risk.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E06 — The D.B. Cooper Job
When a dying FBI agent reveals his greatest failure, Nate becomes obsessed with solving the mystery.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E07 — The Real Fake Car Job
The team fakes the discovery of an antique car in order to convince a Wall Street fraud to break the deal that protects him from prosecution.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E08 — The Broken Wing Job
Parker is left behind on the crew's latest job because of her broken leg; Parker discovers a group of thieves are planning a heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E10 — The Frame-Up Job
Nate must use his investigating skills to clear Sophie's name when she is implicated in the theft of a valuable painting.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E09 — The Rundown Job
Col. Vance, Eliot, Hardison and Parker race to stop a terrorist from launching an attack on Washington.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E11 — The Low Low Price Job
The crew sabotages a mega-store in order to keep it from destroying a small town.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E12 — The White Rabbit Job
The team must run a difficult con in order to prevent a businessman from destroying his company and the town it supports.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E13 — The Corkscrew Job
The team travels into Oregon wine country to steal a rare bottle of wine as part of their current con.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E14 — The Toy Job
The team creates a global toy craze to take on a CEO who is about to release a dangerous toy onto the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S05 E15 — The Long Good-bye Job
The team embarks on its riskiest con yet when Nate takes a case linked to his son's death.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E01 — The Nigerian Job
After recovering stolen airplane designs, Nate's team must figure out how to return them to the rightful owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E02 — The Homecoming Job
In order to help a wounded reservist, the team tries to expose the truth about a security firm.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E07 — The Wedding Job
The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E09 — The Snow Job
The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

S01 E05 — And the Apple of Discord
When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E06 — And the Fables of Doom
The Librarians travel to a town where fairy tales are coming to life and attacking!

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E07 — And the Rule of Three
The librarians are forced to intercede when a group of competitive high school students start undercutting each other with witchcraft.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E08 — The Librarians and the Heart of Darkness
The librarians encounter the house behind the legend of all haunted houses and set out to destroy it.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E09 — And the City of Light
An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E10 — And the Loom of Fate
When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians.

title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
description: An adventurer (Noah Wyle) and a brilliant archaeologist (Gabrielle Anwar) use a map to search for the fabled mines of King Solomon.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E01 — And the Drowned Book
Jenkins discovers there is something wrong with the library; the librarians are drawn together to solve the mystery of a massive storm that is parked over Manhattan.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E02 — And the Broken Staff
Prospero summons other fictionals in order to retrieve parts of his staff; the librarians find themselves pitted against Frankenstein's monster and Sherlock Holmes' nemesis Moriarty; Flynn and Baird have a disagreement.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E03 — And What Lies Beneath the Stones
Stone, Cassandra and Ezekiel team up to investigate a cave-in at an oil rig site which has unleashed a shape-shifting god who grows in strength when lies are told.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E04 — And the Cost of Education
When students begin disappearing at Wexler College, the librarians head out to investigate; Cassandra gets an offer that is difficult to turn down.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E05 — And the Hollow Men
Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with both amnesia and a collection of the library's missing artifacts; the group pursues the Staff of Zarathustra.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E06 — And the Infernal Contract
Baird's old friend finds himself embroiled in a scandal in the form of a missing intern and a contract with the devil; Baird must battle for the souls of all the librarians.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E07 — And the Image of Image
When people begin suffering the effects of accidents and sins in which they have not been involved, the team tracks the connection to Dorian Gray.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E08 — And the Point of Salvation
The team is sent to a high-tech research facility where the researchers have been turned into mindless monsters by a bizarre power source in the center's lab.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E09 — And the Happily Ever Afters
The team scatters and each person begins living the ideal version of their life; the appearance of Ariel brings everyone together to investigate.

title: The Librarians
description:
S02 E10 — And the Final Curtain
The librarians discover that Prospero's magic is wreaking havoc with the technology of the world; Flynn and Baird must travel back to 1611, while the rest of the team battles Prospero in the present.
